title: Bienvenue à la Maison de la Photographie de Marrakech - Maison De La Photographie de Marrakech
facts: Maison de la Photographie in Marrakech displays photographic archives and exhibitions relating to Morocco.
The museum’s stated purpose is to show Morocco’s diversity through historical photographs.
The museum gives its address as 46 rue Ahl Fes, Bin Lafnadek.
